name: minkowski_build_headers_fixed
command: source "$1/environment.sh"; export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 LIBRARY_PATH="$CONDA_PREFIX/lib:$CUDA_HOME/lib"; cd "$1/runtime/MinkowskiEngine"; exec python setup.py install --force_cuda --blas=openblas --blas_include_dirs="$CONDA_PREFIX/include" --cuda_home="$CUDA_HOME"
